groups.saying_opens: قرأ ابن عباس ألا إنهم يثنون صدورهم

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads: Ibn Abbas's reading and gloss (saying 1), and the gloss «وقال غيره عن ابن عباس» through an unnamed «غيره» (saying 2).
«وقال مجاهد {أنيب} أرجع» is a one-word gloss whose saying is shorter than the three-word opening, so it is not stored; this is a deliberate cut, not a reading.
The glosses in braces are quoted words, not links.
